description: Rank the top 25 FLOP inference miners by Scout's routing score. Returns top[] (rank, address, score, chain_rate: on-chain settled fraction 0-1, chain_sessions, local_rate and local_latency_s from Scout's own calls, models, best_price) and best. Advisory only: the FLOP gateway assigns miners, so this cannot select one. For one miner over time use flop_miner_history.
name: flop_miner_ranking
